applicabilityBasis.summary: XUSD is a U.S. dollar stablecoin issued by StraitsX with 1:1 USD redemption and monthly reserve attestations.

genius.notes: StraitsX MAS licensing and XUSD reserve attestations do not establish a U.S. GENIUS permitted-issuer approval or foreign-issuer exception. Under the GENIUS Act, StraitsX would need to register with the OCC as a foreign payment stablecoin issuer (FPSI) to offer XUSD to U.S. persons. No such application has been filed or announced as of 2026-06-18. StraitsX's own blog positions XUSD as B2B/Asia-focused; no US-market authorisation is claimed.
